_comment.purpose: The remote counterparty for the execution boundary. scripts/remote-execution-proof.ts needs a receiver that is genuinely not on this machine and that keeps its own record of what it received. This is the smallest thing that satisfies both: it accepts one POST and echoes a receipt carrying n8n's own $execution.id, and because n8n logs every execution it leaves behind a record the application cannot write to, cannot edit, and does not own. That record is what the independent read-back in n8n/evidence/lead-rescue-remote-execution.json is fetched from.
_comment.deliberatelyNot: It contains NO business logic. Classification, authority, policy, and idempotency all live in the application and are not re-implemented or second-guessed here — the same discipline lead-rescue-ingress.json states for the inbound direction. A transport seam that starts making decisions stops being a seam.
_comment.blastRadius: It forwards nothing. No email, SMS, chat, or onward webhook leaves this workflow, so nothing on this path can reach a customer however the application is configured.
_comment.provenance: Authored as n8n Workflow SDK source and created through the n8n MCP; this JSON is the deployed definition read back from the instance, kept here so the receiver is version-controlled alongside the evidence that depends on it.
